articles.summary: CNW Group: H.I.G. Capital Sells Minority Stake in Portfolio Company myKaarma. H.I.G. Growth Partners ("H.I.G. Growth"), the dedicated growth capital investment affiliate of H.I.G. Capital, a leading global alternative investment firm with $74 billion of capital under management, is pleased to announce that it has sold a minority stake in its portfolio company myKaarma, a leading provider of end-to-end service lane solutions for automotive dealerships, to Warburg Pincus, a leading global growth investing firm.
